findings: Owner request 2026-11-08: practice MCQs for Chapter 1 in the same format as the book-exercise MCQs (keyed checkpoints with a short explanation), English and Roman Urdu. These MCQs are written from the chapter; they are not printed in the book. 121 MCQs, numbered 1-121, under the chapter's section headings: 1.1 9, 1.2 32, 1.3 11, 1.4 28, 1.5 9, 1.6 12, 1.7 20.

Coverage: base and derived quantities, SI base and derived units (Tables 1.1, 1.2) and the additional units SI permits, SI conventions, prefixes (Table 1.3) and unit conversions, scientific notation, counting significant figures, the book's rounding rules (including the odd/even rule for a dropped 5), the addition/subtraction and multiplication/division rules, limitations of significant figures, the thumb rules (mean deviation, periodic uncertainty, total uncertainty, precision/accuracy), absolute, fractional and percentage uncertainty, digital instruments, precision versus accuracy, total uncertainty (sums, quotients, power factor), dimensions, homogeneity, derivation by dimensions and its limitations, and the boxes (Think over!, Do You Know?, For Your Information, Interesting Information, Beware!). Worked examples 1.1-1.4 and the Quick Quiz are used with changed numbers.

Keys: a 30, b 30, c 31, d 30. Every numerical key was recomputed in Python; every key was checked against the lesson text of the section cited in its explanation. None of the 16 exercise MCQs is repeated.

Book errors avoided: no question uses the printed Moon-to-Earth light time, the galaxy position on the distance chart, the µ symbol for the atomic mass unit, or the 0.1 cm / 0.5 A misprints in the 1.5 and 1.6 examples.
The Roman Urdu file has the same blocks, order, option ids and keys; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
